definition: A four-event leave-one-action-out retrospective benchmark for action-specific residual transfer on New York City taxi-zone mobility.
single_new_question: When a strong history-only forecast is fixed first, can a DAM-GK action residual learned from three real institutional changes improve the fourth held-out action consistently, while corrupted action semantics and spatial scope perform worse?

design_response: Use the strongest V4 history-only model as a fixed forecast backbone.
Predict only the action-conditioned residual instead of the full state.
Replace one held-out event with four equal-weight outer folds.
Require correct action semantics to beat every frozen corruption family.

supports_on_finalization: reproducible model-held-out transfer evidence across four known NYC taxi actions
equal-event evidence for incremental action value over a strong historical forecast
mechanism-specific evidence from frozen action and spatial-scope corruptions
Runtime-R4 multi-fold isolation, commitment and replay evidence
does_not_support: causal effects of any taxi fee or congestion-pricing policy
generalization beyond NYC yellow taxis or beyond the four admitted actions
complete universal GWM, UWM or DAM-GK validity

forbidden_model_features: outer fold ID as a learned feature

events.action: USD 2.50 yellow-taxi congestion surcharge for applicable Manhattan trips
citywide taximeter fare and surcharge component adjustment
USD 0.75 per-trip yellow-taxi charge associated with the Congestion Relief Zone

split_contract.outer_fold_rule: The held-out event contributes its 52 pre-action weeks to test input and graph construction, but none of its 12 post-action target weeks to fitting, normalization, selection or graph construction.
split_contract.inner_selection_rule: Within each outer training set, hyperparameters are selected by three-fold leave-one-training-action-out validation and then refit on all three training actions.
split_contract.event_weighting: Each of the four outer held-out events has equal weight regardless of trip volume.

graph_contract.origin_destination_flow: Event-specific top-eight outgoing OD relations built only from that event's 52 pre-action weeks.
graph_contract.action_exposure: One self relation per zone carrying the frozen numeric action exposure for that event.

model_contract.strong_backbone: nonspatial historical autoregression selected because it was the best frozen V4 formal model
model_contract.candidate: action-conditioned multi-relation DAM-GK residual correction over the fixed backbone forecast
model_contract.matched_no_action: same backbone and residual architecture with action inputs removed
model_contract.zero_action_anchor: the action residual is regularized toward zero when the numeric action is zero
model_contract.ensemble_rule: arithmetic mean in raw count space after every seed emits the complete fold key set

evaluation.primary_error: equal-event macro pre-action-normalized MAE over 263 zones, four targets and five reported horizons

paired_bootstrap.unit: Taxi Zone within outer event fold
paired_bootstrap.event_aggregation: equal-weight mean of the four fold-level paired differences

conditions: mean fold skill over the history AR backbone is at least 1 percent
the paired bootstrap interval for candidate minus history backbone is entirely below zero
the candidate improves at least three of four outer held-out events
no outer fold degrades by more than 2 percent relative to the history backbone
at least 12 of 16 event-target pairs improve
at least four of five equal-event reported horizons improve
the correct action beats every frozen control in equal-event macro score
the correct action beats every frozen control in at least three of four folds

model_runtime_denied_routes: other model predictions for the current fold
formal evaluator outputs before all fold commitments
runtime_r4.formal_evaluator_permitted_after: all models, controls, seeds and four outer folds are committed and replayed

benchmark_complete_when: all four event bundles and outer folds validate
Runtime-R4, submission contracts and evaluator are frozen before formal predictions
all required models, controls and seeds emit complete predictions for all four folds
all committed predictions replay within the frozen tolerance
the frozen evaluator emits the full result regardless of gate outcome
data previews, comparisons, failures, hashes and claim boundaries are published
